title: Caught
steps: Almost there: the way down to the dormitory is just ahead.
Suddenly Dask steps out of the dark in front of you. Caught.
What are three first-years doing out of bed at this hour?
We were only checking the slab that comes and goes, sir! To make sure it did not get lost in the dark!
Dask looks at the three of you for a long moment in silence. Then the smallest of smiles.
I have been watching you. You looked before every step, you waited, you lit the dark; very clever work. I shall let you go, just this once, {wizard}.

He walks away up the corridor, and the three of you go on through the arch. Safe under the blankets, you remember all you learned tonight: you counted the cells and asked where things are with `position`, used a question, an expression, to know whether it was safe, chose your way with `if` and `else`, and got through the dark with the loops `for` and `while` and the spells *kirra* and *osto*. Hugging the secret the three of you now share, you fall asleep at last, the castle feeling like home.
